case.title: 'pipeline' begins with the keyword 'pipe' and must match as piped_home

submissions.open_text: Household of six shares two jerrycans daily.
submissions.voice_transcript: The county pipeline reaches our plot now.

submissions.open_text: Children miss school fetching water after rains fail.

case.why: A keyword matches at the start of a word, so 'pipe' matches the start of 'pipeline' and the source heard is piped_home. No earlier word begins any keyword ('The', 'county' do not). Piped_home differs from the form's vendor, so the check fires. An implementation that requires whole-word matches would find no keyword and stay silent.
